steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Rhodes Island sure is taking their time.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We're almost at the interception point!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Tch, finally... I just finished unpacking.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What a waste.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Hurry up! Those in the back, follow more closely!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hey, masked person over there.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Who is it? !

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: All of you, come at me. I'm short on time.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Amiya, Texas from Penguin Logistics has returned.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ahh... what a relief!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I have an update here.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I just took care of some guys who called themselves 'Reunion.'

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ... But there are a lot more of them coming.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Reunion has come out of hiding and are starting to move in groups.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's as I feared...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Reunion has already infiltrated Lungmen through the slums...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And their target... is the same as ours.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Otherwise, there would be no reason for them to come after Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Miss Misha is carrying secrets that only Lungmen and Reunion know.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We're caught in a disadvantageous situation.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Things aren't looking good for us right now.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I'll really have to poke that officer's pretty little face later to find out what's actually going on.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...Anything else to add?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: If not, I'll lead the way. I know exactly where to go!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Exusiai has confirmed our escape route. I'll now take you through it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Franka, gather all the squads. We--

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: We... should find cover first.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Reunion is already here.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Over here! Don't let them get away!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: There's nothing more annoying than when trouble keeps nipping at your tail.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Something's wrong.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They... have a leader!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Watch out!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Skullshatterer, they're right here. Yes, that's her!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Casters, go! Tear them to shreds!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: They mean business...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Watch out! The enemy has deployed multiple casters! Prepare appropriate countermeasures!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What they're after is...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Misha!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Aah... Who... are you...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Finally...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: I've finally... found you.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Who are you...?!
